jobs.title: C# Web Software Developer
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

We are looking for a good and passionate software developer working for Life Science Industry, using professional equipments and tools, architecting, designing, implementing and unit testing different system functionalities for a web platform fulfilling bio store needs. You will have the unique opportunity to contribute along other engineers and scientists to the development of solutions that revolutionize medical research & treatment techniques and instruments.
The ideal candidate should be a smart, open minded person and open to travel, able to parse through functional requirements and technical design documents to come up with proper architecture and implementation to provide good software quality and support to our clients.

EXPERIENCE

Experience in web software development with C# .NET and DataBase is mandatory
Web development skills are mandatory (JavaScript frameworks)
Database development skills are mandatory (SQL Server, PostGreSQL or other)
OOP skills / SOLID principle with clean architecture are mandatory
AI code assist is a plus (i.e. GitHUb Copilot)
B.S. / M.S. in Engineering or Computer Science is preferred

RESPONSIBILITIES

Reviewing and understanding the requirements
Architecting, designing, coding and unit testing product functionalities
Integrating software modules and third party apps
Be a strong full-time contributor to the project, with minimum technical supervision
Communicate with UK based customers

Location: Timisoara

Take advantage of this opportunity to move your career forward!

jobs.title: .NET Software Engineer
jobs.description:
The Team

Sportcast is widely recognized as the leader in sports betting player engagement through their product experiences, technologies and pricing. We invented BetBuilder, and our award-winning original continues to pioneer sports betting experiences. Billions of combinations, within single sporting events, immerse players deeply in the story they build. Players want more. More access to every possible betting opportunity, every event combination, for every sport. Thrilling betting moments. Created by players. Now part of OpenBet. We've brought together the developers, statisticians, data scientists powering the future of sports betting. They build the odds and prices for billions - and soon trillions - of game eventualities. The ultimate features. Any combination. Every sports story.

SportCast x OpenBet
is a team that you want to be part of! Come join us.

We are looking for a passionate .Net Software Engineer
to support Sportcast's growth from our European offices.

As a Software Developer in the Trade team, you will work as part of a cross-functional team that develops, deploys, and supports its own projects and outcomes. You will have the opportunity to work on varied projects to write testable and maintainable code. Being a team player, you will enjoy participating in team design, scoping, and prioritisation discussions. These teams' focus is to assist the business in delivering scaling while also maintaining high quality.

The role will involve the development and maintenance of our real-time systems.

What You Will Be Doing

Develop high quality, high-performing code which meets the business need
Optimise our solutions to ensure we support our service levels and minimise cloud costs
Automate processes wherever possible
Challenge the status quo. Help improve our patterns, standards and procedures across the organisation

The Player

3+ years of experience with .NET/.NET Core and C#
Exposure to Unit Testing, Serverless technologies such as Azure Functions, and containerized microservices using Azure Container Apps or AWS equivalents
Expertise in SQL-based databases including MSSQL and PostgreSQL
Experience with GitHub/ GitFlow workflow branch strategy
Strong communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to diverse audiences
Effective team player in cross-functional, multi-disciplinary teams, with a strong collaborative mindset
Strategic and resourceful problem solver, focused on delivering secure, scalable, and value-driven solutions iteratively
Exposure to high-volume, mission-critical systems with performance and reliability requirements
Prior experience in the wagering or gaming industry is a plus

What's the Score?

What We Can Offer YOU

We have a collaborative hybrid office environment with our team members at least 3 days per week
Attractive benefits, an open and supportive environment as well as a modern and exciting workplace
The opportunity to interact with global teams on a regular basis as you and our business continues to develop & grow
Tangible and genuine development - at OpenBet, you can take your career where you want it to go!
And if that's not enough; enjoy flexible working whilst we provide you with the guidance and development skills you need to progress and enhance your career

At OpenBet, we celebrate diversity and believe in creating an inclusive environment where every voice is valued and respected. We're committed to building a team that reflects the rich tapestry of humanity, embracing individuals from all walks of life, backgrounds, and identities. Join us in shaping the future of iGaming, where diversity isn't just celebrated—it's celebrated.

jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer Microsoft Azure (w/m/x)
jobs.description:
Willkommen bei BEKO – Österreichs führendem Anbieter technischer Dienstleistungen. Seit über 50 Jahren arbeiten wir bei BEKO an modernen Lösungen und wegweisenden Zukunftsideen für Unternehmen jeder Branche und Größe. Mit einem bunten Team aus kreativen Köpfen und dem gebündelten Know-How von IT-Spezialisten und Engineering-Expertinnen denken wir quer, weiter und voraus. Dabei glauben wir vor allem an eines: Fortschritt in allen Farben.

Aber wir bei BEKO reden nicht nur von der Zukunft. Wir arbeiten daran. Vielleicht schon bald mit dir?

Aufgaben

Konzipieren und Umsetzen moderner Cloud-Anwendungen auf Basis von Microsoft Azure
Weiterentwickeln bestehender Softwarelösungen und Infrastrukturen im Cloud-Umfeld
Begleiten des gesamten Entwicklungszyklus von der technischen Konzeption bis zum produktiven Einsatz
Optimieren von Performance, Stabilität und Wartbarkeit bestehender Cloud-Services
Abstimmen technischer Anforderungen und Lösungen mit internen Fachbereichen wie IT und Produktmanagement

Profil

Das bringst du mit

Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich (HTL, FH oder Universität)
Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Microsoft Azure und C#
Erfahrung im Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung komplexer Cloud-Architekturen
Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Das ist von Vorteil

Erfahrung mit Terraform
Know-how im Bereich Azure Synapse Analytics

Angebot

Kein All-In-Vertrag: aufgrund moderner Arbeitszeitmodelle kann flexibel Zeitausgleich konsumiert werden
Wir bieten ein Gehalt von mindestens 4.400,- € Brutto auf Basis Vollzeit bei Erfüllung aller Anforderungen. Je nach konkreter Qualifikation und Erfahrung ist eine Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung gegeben.

jobs.title: Software Developer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As a Software Developer in our IT team, you develop applications based on various technologies and thus drive the digitalization and automation of our processes. You analyze internal requirements and develop suitable solution concepts. Your responsibilities cover the entire development process from design to programming, the test phase and implementation to the further development of the respective software solutions.

YOUR ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Backend software development and maintenance of business-critical applications
Design, development and integration of RESTful APIs, JSON and other interfaces between internal and external systems
Troubleshooting and resolving issues in production environments
SQL development and maintenance of SQL code (MS SQL)
Planning and implementation of system integrations (e.g. EDI connections) as well as adaptations of the workflow-based ERP system
Software-related IT support and ticket handling

WHAT YOU BRING

You enjoy programming, testing and launching creative software solutions
You work in a structured, independent and goal-oriented manner
You have strong analytical skills
You are passionate about quality, innovation and digitalization
You enjoy working in a young, dynamic and multicultural team

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

Proven experience in backend development in a production environment
Solid knowledge of databases (MS SQL) - writing and optimizing SQL queries, stored procedures and database administration
Good understanding of RESTful APIs, JSON and communication protocols between applications and servers
Experience troubleshooting issues in a production environment
Programming skills in C# are an advantage; experience with any modern programming language is welcome
Experience with system integrations (e.g. EDI, APIs) is a plus
Knowledge of UI/UX/design and workflow applications is a plus
Knowledge of Python is a plus
You have good English skills; German is a plus

WE OFFER:

Depending on your qualifications and experience, the gross monthly salary starts at €3,700. We are happy to offer a higher salary depending on your experience and qualifications.

Flexible working hours
A secure position within a family-oriented company culture in a stable and future-focused industry
The opportunity to work in a young, dynamic team
Ongoing training and professional development opportunities

Social benefits

Free parking directly at the office
Complimentary shuttle service to and from Wörgl train station
Discounted fuel at our on-site filling station (diesel)
Company bike leasing program for sustainable mobility
Monthly grocery allowance
Health and wellness benefits, including an occupational physician, vaccination programs, and team sports activities
Regular company events and team-building activities
Support in finding accommodation
